title: Be careful down by the beach, theyre tagging cars in an insurance scam
content: Yep, pretty much the title. I was driving to the beach and some guy was on a motorized skateboard slapping cars and then some dipshit in his huge tonka truck looking ass doulie would fly out in front of you to try and cause a collison on the back end of their truck so they can make an insurance claim. I ran over the the dude on the skateboard so maybe them being in recovery will stave them off for a bit 🙄🙄🙄😅😅😅 its always so crunk in there every night just total choas i just want to understand 🥲🥴
